    def forward(self, x):
        x = F.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
        x = F.max_pool2d(x, 2)
        x = F.relu(self.bn2(self.conv2(x)))
        x = F.max_pool2d(x, 2)
        x = x.view(-1, 32 * 8 * 8)
        x = F.relu(self.fc1(x))
        x = self.fc2(x)
        return x
